title: I built an Anime offline gacha rpg with Codex and Godot
author: RuinousFate
selftext:
Thank you for all the resets this last month. Progress was much faster than expected and I didn't think I'd create something on this level. I'm a programmer by trade so I do have some experience using AI at work. I will say most of the time was spent on refining things than actually creating except for the initial burst at the start of development.  
  
A good chunk of my time was spent on refining the art if anything and it's still not perfect obviously.
